Hunters Adrian Knops and Garrett Hagen venture into a remote part of Alaska's Misty Fjord, hunting moose and bear; after a successful hunt, Adrian finds himself trapped by a twenty-foot tidal surge after Garrett fails to return with the skiff.

st: Stranded in the Alaska Wild Part 2
d: Adrian Knopps shares the details of his ordeal in the remote parts of Alaska's Misty Fjord, after finding himself trapped by a tidal surge.
Humans are attacked by bears.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea
d: In Newquay, teams search for an aircraft following reports it's crashed at sea; Humberside Search and Rescue help a woman who fell walking her dog on the cliffs.

In Yorkshire, Neil needs urgent attention after a fall from his motorbike; the medics head to the banks of Ullswater when a walker goes into a cardiac arrest; in Berkshire, Darran suffers nasty burns in an accident lighting a bonfire.

After his leg is crushed by a boulder, Gregg Hein is stranded on a high Sierra peak with an infected compound fracture. Knowing he won't be reported missing for days, Gregg attempts to crawl off the mountain and rescue himself.

On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corps Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harm's way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself. This is a story of survival on and off the battlefield.
As rain pounds Britain, it's up to road rescue to make it to trapped motorists through the gale, if they can make it at all.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea
d: Brave volunteers face treacherous landscapes to rescue those in peril across the UK.
A freak car accident in Cumbria leaves Richard fighting for his life; in Hampshire, horse rider Pat takes a nasty fall when her animal is spooked.
Customs confront tax evasion and smuggling in a high-stakes operation across Ireland.

A woman arrives at Heathrow from Cape Town claiming she's there for a training course; in reality, she's come to earn money to send back home; officer Kay Lomas is handed the case of a "student" who is trying to re-enter the country from India.

At a reporting center, asylum seekers, foreign criminals and those caught working illegally come to make weekly reports and show they are following instructions while their paperwork and legal status is processed.
TSG, a special unit, fights against every Nothing Hill gang.
Women are not well represented in the police, but they play a key role in India and Palestine where they deal with special cases involving women.
Officials uncover packages of weaponry that include tasers and nunchucks, as well as another set of packages filled with cigarettes worth millions of Euros.
Wedding season means out-of-control bachelor and bachelorette parties.
Costumed crazies crash and burn; the team has its hands full.
An unconscious girl arrives on an office chair and a guy is knocked out cold, right in front of the medics; it's messy, loud and nonstop for the Street Hospital team.
Wellington erupts with festival fever; medics battle overdoses, back-alley injuries and one frustrated drunk boy.
Alfie the dog tracks down a large shipment of drugs in Rosslare, customs officials catch a couple carrying stolen credit cards and there is a problematic shipment of bananas in Cork.
Gang wars and bloody struggles have made Acapulco less attractive for foreign tourists; members of special anti-criminal unit risk their lives every day to maintain security.

A rock-climbing disaster hurtles climber Craig DeMartino 100 feet down a granite cliff. A shattered heap of broken bones, Craig clings to life. In a split second, Craig's life becomes an inspiring fight to survive.
An accident leaves a fisherman fighting for his life after becoming trapped under a boulder, with water reaching up to his neck.
A man's visit to an African chimp sanctuary turns deadly; Siberian tiger breaks free at a zoo; a police officer faces an angry bull.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea
d: A fell runner breaks her leg in the Ochil Hills and must remain calm while rescue teams figure out the best way to extract her; in Portscatho, a dog gets stuck on a cliff; the Keswick Mountain Rescue team help some injured walkers.
Chris suffers multiple injuries after a quad bike accident on a farm near Penrith; cyclist Vivienne is in a bad way after her bike leaves a notorious Cumbrian pass.

After Justin Harris severely breaks his leg deep in a remote, Utah canyon, it's up to his brother Jeremy to climb out for help. Clawing his way through icy pools of water and up rock faces, pushes Jeremy to his limit.

Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.
Caught in the crosshairs of a terrible accident, a family's life is thrown into chaos.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea
d: Humberside Search and Rescue rush to Thornwick Bay to help a man who has suspected head and spinal injuries; in the Lake District, Maria's walking holiday is cut short.

In County Durham, heli-medics battle to keep Mick alive after a massive seizure; twelve-year-old Ollie faces a limb-threatening injury at the motocross track; in the Yorkshire Dales there's a dramatic hillside rescue for paraglider Alastair.
Customs officers at Dublin Airport uncover hidden weapons, banned creams, and more surprises.
Police crack down on illegal immigrants during rush hour in Calais, France.
A man from Pakistan claiming to be a student is refused entry into Britain after two days of questioning.

Rio de Janeiro is famous for its sea-coasts and beaches loved by tourists from all over the world. Behind this postcard image, 20 percent of the population lives in shanty towns called favelas. In these zones drug dealers make their own rules.
Sinchi, a special anti-drug group, was created in order to fight the drug trade in the Peruvian forest area.
Customs officers tackle smuggling challenges at Irish ports and airports.
The heat's turned up and so is the drama; two tourists clash with police over boozy behavior; Sean and Hollie treat a man whose foot gets crushed by a taxi.
Elizabeth meets a man with giant rats; Braden's thrown into the deep end and rowdy bystanders just won't quit; the medics hustle hard to keep up with the madness.

Marine Anne Hjelle was mountain biking when she was ripped off her bike by a mountain lion. Anne fought back even as the big cat shredded her face in its jaws. Surviving the attack was only the beginning of Anne's incredible fight to survive.

Craig DeMartino examines the stories of other survivors he's met across the season. Their survival stories are all different, but Craig discovers that these survivors share more in common than you might think.
An Australian man gets attacked by a white shark while diving; a swimmer is attacked off the coast of Alabama.

On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corps Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harm's way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself. This is a story of survival on and off the battlefield.

A bass fishing trip goes horribly wrong when a bolt of lightning strikes their boat, leaving Seventeen-year-old Christian Neal burned and unconscious and his father Gabe blown into the water and paralyzed. It will take a miracle to save them.
A family is stalked by a wolf while camping; a man is attacked by a rabid coyote while mowing his lawn; a cyclist is pounced on by a cougar.

A father and son set out on a cliffside sheep hunt, but one slip could mean life or death in the remote and unforgiving area.
Father and son bow hunters fight off a deadly grizzly bear attack.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea
d: Brave volunteers risk life and limb to rescue adventurers in the UK's perilous landscapes.

In Hartlepool, the heli-medics are tasked with treating a man hit by a train; cyclist Trevor suffers serious injuries after a collision with a car; motocross biker Arai in Cumbria is flown across the country for emergency surgery.
A woman's car gets seized, another woman at the airport claims her weapons are fake despite them actually being real, and a third traveler refuses to let her bags get X-rayed.

Immigration officer Lisa Lea checks the passport of a man from Pakistan who says he's doing marketing for his fruit and vegetable business; Lisa is suspicious about his passport stamps and finds out he's running illegal businesses.

At Heathrow's Terminal Three, officers stop a student from entering the UK after a trip home to his native India, while the team in Calais search lorries they suspect are being used to smuggle illegal immigrants.
The center of trafficking is the Paraná river, separating Brazil and Paraguay, where the Brazilian government has established a special police unit called NEPOM.

st: Police of the Wealthy vs. Police of the Poor
d: In Buenos Aires and Haiti, the government establishes a special police department aimed to work in the marginal neighborhoods and reassure the public.
Suspected swallower, illegal cigs, a pistol, and a coal ship search.
Heavy partying has already started the weekend before Christmas.
Paramedic Jeff contends with bizarre antics from bystanders.

The holiday season hits Coast Guard Alaska with falling temperatures and intense rescue missions across the state; a hunting excursion in Sitka goes terribly wrong when a man is shot in the back and a rescue team races to the scene.
In Dover, a giant X-ray machine helps officers tackle industrial scale smugglers hoping to hide amongst the thousands of trucks flooding through the port each day.
